name: Lee
tagline: Fills shopping carts at the big-box stores from your list, then stops there
description: Hand it a plain shopping list and it builds filled carts at the major big-box retailers instead of a page of links. Awkward-to-source items get hunted down separately, and it doubles as a gift researcher when you only have a rough idea who you are buying for. It stops once the cart is built - paying stays with you.
author: GallagherPreach
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
